native_context: Microsoft Entra delegated/app-only permissions and tenant binding
taxonomy_note: Planning compatibility lens only. Classify the final observed root cause independently; unsupported mappings stay unassigned.

controls.boundary: Microsoft Entra delegated/app-only permissions and tenant binding — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Collect app/service-principal identity, tenant, consent/grants, token type/claims and the resource API's enforcement. Distinguish delegated scopes from application roles.
controls.controlled_verification: Trace one protected API operation under an intended delegated or app-only context, then compare an owned wrong-tenant or insufficient-grant fixture. Determine whether the API uses the correct grant semantics and caller/account binding rather than merely checking that a token is signed.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Admin consent or a broad permission listing is not proof the application exercises unintended authority. A delegated token and an app-only token cannot be evaluated with interchangeable assumptions.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Enforce the intended tenant, issuer, token purpose and operation-specific scope/role, and narrow unnecessary grants. Retest the legitimate integration and the evidenced wrong context.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
